entries.70a186ac074ca67e: A business that buys and sells used motorcycles. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,748 million, making it the largest business. It attracts customers through digital marketing, accepts online appraisals on its own website "Bike Kaitori.com", and collects vehicles through on-site appraisals made by visiting customers' homes. Most of the motorcycles purchased are sold at inter-dealer auctions, and some are sold directly to users at "Bikeland Direct Sales Center". It operates under the single brand "Bikeland", with purchase bases in the Kanto, Kansai, Tokai, Tohoku and Kyushu regions.
